keyPointsEn: RSI successfully exited oversold from 43.9 to 56.6, strengthening the buy signal.
MACD histogram improved from -0.8889 to 0.0908, suggesting resolution of bearish convergence and potential bullish reversal.
Although the volume ratio is low at 0.46, indicating low confidence in current price action, the improvement in RSI and MACD warrants consideration for a buy entry.
